Unmortgaging Tennessee Avenue would complete the orange monopoly for the opponent. They already own St. James and New York, both mortgaged. Trading it to them would give them a full set with no rent benefit.

I will not trade cash or Tennessee Avenue. Cash would help them survive Virginia Avenue's rent. Tennessee would complete their orange monopoly.

I will not trade Get Out of Jail Free cards. The opponent owns every property and has no assets I want, so trading offers no benefit. The only viable path is to keep four houses on all three pink properties and freeze the bank's housing supply, waiting for them to land on a pink twice or fail to pay rent. Rolling from Mediterranean Avenue would not land on any pink property. The main risks are light blue properties and a Chance card. I now have $2,166, so I can pay the $1,300 rent on Park Place with four houses and the $2,000 rent on Boardwalk hotel without selling any buildings. I am now considering whether to offer cash for Boardwalk to remove the $2,000 rent threat. The opponent would not accept a trade that gives them Boardwalk or light blue properties.
